title: The person behind the calipers: a lab profile
intro: A short portrait of the technician who keeps the reference instruments honest and the fridge stocked.

add_image.image_alt: A researcher at the bench with instruments
add_image.image_caption: At the reference bench, where the instruments are checked.
add_image.content_to_show_on_side_of_the_image_whe: Most of the lab's measurements pass through this bench in one direction or another. It is where a sensor becomes trustworthy enough to take into the field, and where it is checked again when it comes back.

add_content_to_page.add_paragraph: The work is not dramatic. It is a sequence of small refusals: refusing to accept a calibration because it looked fine, refusing to skip the blank, refusing to let a series enter the archive with a missing temperature log.

add_quote.text: My job is to be the least interesting part of a result. If nobody notices my work in the paper, it went well.

add_content_to_page.add_paragraph: The bench has one rule that is written nowhere: anything that breaks gets a note before it gets a replacement. The notes, over time, are more useful than the equipment list.
